name: hcportal_bulkAddHashers
description: Bulk adds or updates hashers (members) for a kennel from a JSON array: creates HC.Hasher rows for unknown emails, creates or reactivates HC.HasherKennelMap memberships (never-expires 2999-12-31), and updates historical run / haring counts. A cursor walks the rows in input order inside ONE transaction; results are matched back to input rows by position (rowNo), not by email. Two callers: the paste grid (@fromImport = 0, original behaviour) and "Import from file" (@fromImport = 1, E2.F2.S6, 2026-10-10). In import mode: a row may carry matchPublicHasherId (the admin said it IS that member — must have a live HKM row here) and updateEmail = 1 (replace the member's email, honoured only under the 2026-09-23 ownership rule, re-checked here: never signed in, no device, home kennel is this one or none, and no other account holds the address); a row with no email (or an unclaimed hc-…@noemail.invalid placeholder) is matched to a live kennel member by hash name, else first + last name, and otherwise gets a fresh hc-<12 hex>@noemail.invalid placeholder; people already in the kennel keep everything except HISTORIC counts, which take the file's numbers when > 0; every hasher the import adds gets an invite code. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId as the callerParamString. Gate: the caller's HKM row for the kennel must carry AppAccessFlags & 0x40000081 (superAdmin | authIsAdmin). Bit 0x0001 of KennelStanding (the old automated MEMBER bit) is retired since 2026-10-13: membership is MembershipExpirationDate and nothing else, and this SP no longer calls HC6.nonApi_syncMemberStandingBit (dropped).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId as the paramString.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Auth/routing: public kennel ID for which hashers are being bulk added. Required. Used as paramString for auth token validation.

parameters.name: newHasherJson
parameters.description: JSON array of row objects: publicHasherId, publicKennelId, firstName, lastName, eMail, hashName, historicTotalRuns (int), historicHaring (int), addHasherStatus, and (import only) matchPublicHasherId (GUID string) and updateEmail (smallint 1). Must be non-NULL and at least 5 characters. String fields are read as NVARCHAR(500).

parameters.name: fromImport
parameters.description: 1 = called by Import from file (E2.F2.S6): name matching for rows without email, placeholder addresses, matchPublicHasherId / updateEmail, already-in-kennel rows left untouched except historic counts, invite codes for added hashers. 0 (default) = the paste grid, original behaviour.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on any validation, auth, or runtime error. Short-circuits on first error.

rowsets.name: BulkAddResult
rowsets.description: Returned on success, one row per input row in input order. addHasherStatus values: 'NEW HC USER' (Hasher created), 'NEW MEMBER' (HKM created or reactivated), 'UPDATE RUN COUNTS' (paste grid: historic counts changed), 'NO CHANGE', 'ERROR' (no usable email — row not processed); import mode adds 'ALREADY IN KENNEL', 'RUN COUNTS UPDATED', 'EMAIL UPDATED', 'EMAIL NOT CHANGED' (updateEmail refused by the ownership rule).

columns.name: publicHasherId
columns.description: The hasher's public id (new or existing); NULL for ERROR rows. Overwrites the input value.

columns.name: publicKennelId
columns.description: The public kennel ID from the JSON input (passthrough)

columns.name: firstName
columns.description: First name from the JSON input (passthrough)

columns.name: lastName
columns.description: Last name from the JSON input (passthrough)

columns.name: email
columns.description: The email used: the trimmed input, or the generated hc-…@noemail.invalid placeholder in import mode; the input value when the row was not processed.

columns.name: hashName
columns.description: Hash name from the JSON input (passthrough)

columns.name: historicTotalRuns
columns.description: Historical total run count from the JSON input (passthrough)

columns.name: historicHaring
columns.description: Historical haring count from the JSON input (passthrough)

columns.name: addHasherStatus
columns.description: Processing outcome per row (see rowset description).

sideEffects: INSERT HC.Hasher (PublicHasherId, FirstName, LastName, HashName, Email, HomeKennelId = this kennel, Photo = random bundle://avatar-N) for each processable row whose email no account holds

INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap (UserId, KennelId, Following = 1, MembershipExpirationDate = '2999-12-31') for new memberships; UPDATE an existing row to Following = 1, '2999-12-31' when it is not a current followed membership
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap HistoricalTotalRunCount / HistoricalHaringCount when the input differs (import mode: only when > 0), then EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser
Import mode, updateEmail = 1 and ownership rule passes: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET Email, then EXEC HC6.nonApi_resetEmailStatus (EmailStatus back to Unknown; LOG.GeneralLog line)
Import mode: EXEC HC6.nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode for each 'NEW HC USER' / 'NEW MEMBER'
All writes in one transaction: any row's failure rolls back the whole batch
An import row with no real address that matches nobody is stored under a placeholder derived from kennel + names (deterministic), so re-running the file does not add the person again.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning

Never change the addHasherStatus string values ('NEW HC USER', 'NEW MEMBER', 'UPDATE RUN COUNTS', 'NO CHANGE', 'ERROR', 'ALREADY IN KENNEL', 'RUN COUNTS UPDATED', 'EMAIL UPDATED', 'EMAIL NOT CHANGED') without updating all portal parsing logic
Never change the '2999-12-31' never-expires sentinel date without updating all callers

codeSmells.issue: One over-long field fails the whole batch
codeSmells.detail: OPENJSON reads names and email as NVARCHAR(500) (lines 127-135) but HC.Hasher.FirstName/LastName/HashName/Email are NVARCHAR(250). A value over 250 characters raises 'String or binary data would be truncated' at the INSERT (line 295), which rolls back every row in the transaction. It is logged (CATCH line 421), but no row-level LEN check turns it into an 'ERROR' row.

Lines 88-90 say member-management rights (0x0010 / 0x0002) are accepted; line 96 only accepts 0x40000081 (superAdmin | authIsAdmin), and HC6.CheckKennelPermission is not used, so mismanagement-role grants do not apply.

codeSmells.issue: Raw database error returned to the user
INSERT ... EXEC inside the batch transaction
codeSmells.detail: Line 220 runs nonApi_resetEmailStatus under INSERT-EXEC inside the open transaction; if that proc's CATCH runs, its ROLLBACK is illegal there (error 3915) and the batch fails with a misleading message.
Lines 243-246 compare LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(...))) per row of the kennel inside a cursor; fine for a roster, slow for a very large kennel.

changes: 1.3.0 (2026-10-14): idempotency audit P8 (Idempotent writes: upserts by a natural key). The email lookup now takes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK). An @fromImport row with no real address that matches no kennel member gets a placeholder DERIVED from (kennel, hash name, first name, last name) — hc-<first 12 hex of SHA2_256>@noemail.invalid — instead of NEWID(), and replaces an unheld portal-made placeholder, so a re-run of the same file finds the hasher the first run added. No parameter or rowset change.
